activity_summary: You sat the morning sermon. Master Thwaite preached the prodigal and promised to be brief. Mistress Ansell called an hour and a half timely, and waited for the want. You did not put your own road into it. He did not name a purse.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat it, and kept his own errand out of the text.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached the prodigal, and refused to be brief.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Called an hour and a half timely, and waited for the want.

facets.activity: Sat the sermon on the prodigal

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: An hour and a half, and the boy is still on the road.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Let him get as far as the husks.

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: The far country is far enough without a man's own errand put into it.
